applies_why: The judge text addresses whether the Jeremiah 22:30 verse counts as an unanswered witness against a dropped curse limb, and it does not count it toward a broken link.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: By treating the Jeremiah verse as directed at a dropped limb and leaving no live link to contradict, the judge is not counting it toward a broken link, which obeys K-G4.
